basis: CFG-02 reconcile requirement and r33 actual unknown-receipt incident, after r34 happy-path save/restore acceptance
goal: Add an API-only read-only unit-text reconciliation tool; never repeat an uncertain write automatically
minimumDelivery: Strict operationId / connection / unit / language / approved request-task context; validate existing receipt targetKeyHash and inputHash against the original canonical write request before using caller context

Reuse existing durable receipt, native full-row snapshot and CTS readers; observe value/version, ownership/status and bounded exact-target CTS projection with timestamps, truncation and unavailable reasons

Return observed_requested, observed_original, observed_conflicting or unknown only when observations justify them; retain original receipt status and first cause, especially where later restoration makes historical causation unprovable
Separate current observation from historical write/commit certainty; CTS recorded does not prove current value or transport import, and stale/non-atomic reads do not prove absence
Read-only tool registration, documentation and regression coverage; lock observations only through an already approved diagnostic route, otherwise explicitly unavailable
acceptance: Missing or mismatched receipt/context rejected before SAP reads; no customer writer, append, lock acquisition, release or automatic retry called
Desired/original/conflicting/unknown states covered with incomplete, stale, truncated and unavailable observations; original unknown receipt remains unchanged
Historical r33 and completed r34 receipts used as immutable regression evidence; any live read-only acceptance stays on a frozen isolated build
Current restored KG/ZH row, existing CUNI/T006A key and any diagnostic limitations reported accurately; no claim that current original value proves an earlier command did not write
dependenciesAndLimits: Existing receipt stores hashes rather than complete original input; define narrowly scoped canonical context verification before implementation, do not invent missing before data
Live read-only acceptance requires a temporary login if no authorized isolated session remains; current session closed normally

CFG-02 native stale-under-lock, contention, authority denial and standard API/CTS failure rollback remain pending; design non-destructive fault scenarios first, and seek concrete scope if further business writes are necessary
CFG-03/04/07/08 and full SPRO automation remain subject to scene-specific standard API evidence; do not broaden the unit-text writer into generic table writes
authorization: Local implementation and existing test authorization continue; this plan grants no new business writes, source deployment, CTS removal/release, imports or GUI automation
